BREAKING: Tesla just topped Australia's entire auto market. 🇦🇺

The Tesla Model Y was the country's best-selling vehicle in June, leading all cars, not just electric vehicles.

Tesla delivered 8,670 vehicles during the month, with the Model Y accounting for 8,072 of them.

The Model Y continues to be one of Tesla's strongest performers worldwide.

BREAKING: SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell is donating SpaceX shares to Trump Accounts.

More than 2 million children between the ages of 11 and 17 are expected to receive stock through the program.

Shotwell said the goal is to inspire the next generation "to live and fly amongst the stars."

Another move focused on getting more young people excited about science, technology and space.

BREAKING: Starlink is preparing to bring satellite internet to Nepal and Bhutan through Bangladesh. 🌏

Bangladesh has approved Starlink's cross-border bandwidth export, allowing the company to use IPLC links to serve customers in neighboring countries.

BSCCL will supply the international bandwidth under a three-year agreement, while domestic internet traffic in Bangladesh will remain separate.

Another major step as Starlink expands its footprint across South Asia.

BREAKING: Starlink has brought high-speed internet to Tubusereia Junior High School in Papua New Guinea. 🇵🇬

Students and teachers now have access to fast, reliable internet, opening the door to better educational resources and digital learning opportunities.

Another example of Starlink helping connect underserved communities around the world.
